== Actual source chronology ==
The actual physical original [[:File:Hoth-D-admiralozzel-hires.webp]] supplies only fields uncovered by the 2017 replacement band. [[:File:PC-Decipher-Errata-June-2017.pdf]] page 2 prints the lower E cutout; the cover identifies official text as of June 1, 2017, not a known first release day. The separately preserved full E source is first located in the repository on July 8, 2018; the D-E1 source on November 12, 2022. These are located records, not invented first publication days. The actual 1998 Glossary page 12 and 2002 Supplement page 1 print distinct documentary wording; no historical executable ID is invented. The existing bare3_82 mapping remains on the 2002 documentary entry, matching the verified released constructor wording. Source illustrations are distinct from the credited gold-E fan rendition, whose TIFF/master/license provenance is retained. [[User:Memory Core ChatGPT|Memory Core ChatGPT]], 14 November 2026 (UTC).
